declarations.description:
Continuous strip that scrolls its children in a loop: logo walls, testimonials, ticker tapes. Each child element
is one item. Items keep their own DOM (no copies are made), so page styles, links and listeners keep working; a
child that leaves one edge re-enters at the other. When the items are shorter than the strip, the gap that leaves
shows as empty space before the first item comes round again.

Motion pauses while the pointer is over the strip or focus is inside it, and while `paused` is set. When the
reader asks for reduced motion the strip stops and becomes a row that scrolls by hand.
declarations.name: Marquee

cssProperties.description: Speed in pixels per second (a positive number without a unit).
cssProperties.name: --c2-marquee--speed

cssProperties.description: Length of the fade to transparent at both ends of the strip.
cssProperties.name: --c2-marquee__viewport--fade

cssProperties.description: Cross-axis alignment of items of different sizes: start, center or end.
cssProperties.name: --c2-marquee__item--align

cssParts.description: The clipping window around the moving items.
cssParts.name: viewport

cssParts.description: The moving wrapper around each child of the default slot; one child is assigned to each wrapper.
cssParts.name: item

slots.description: The items, one per child element. Text directly inside the element is not shown.

members.name: orientation
members.description: Direction of travel: `horizontal` moves toward the inline start (left in a left-to-right page), `vertical` moves up.

members.name: reverse
members.description: Moves the items the other way: toward the inline end, or down.

members.name: paused
members.description: Stops the motion where it is.

members.name: manualSlots
members.description: False only when the shadow root came from declarative shadow DOM, which is always in named mode.
